attributes.title: Level 9

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about how to create engaging project screens to enhance the User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX).

questions.hint: Which other functions can be used to display text on screen?
questions.title: [Select one] Which function can be used to display text on screen?
questions.correctResponse: All of the functions listed can be used to display text on screen! The text sprite and story extensions allow you to further customize how the text appears.

questions.hint: Which tools might be used for each action in the paint editor?
questions.title: [Match one per answer] How can each tool in the paint editor be used to create large (160 x 120) background image assets?

statements.text: Look closely at one area at a time
View a different area of the image
Move a selection of the image to a different position

questions.correctResponse: There are lots of useful tools in the paint editor that make designing large background image assets easier!

questions.hint: Pressing Alt + Shift and letter keys (A-F) to access colors 10-15
questions.title: [Select one] What is the key press shortcut to outline an image in brown (color number 14) ?
questions.correctResponse: The color brown is color 14, which corresponds to the letter E since colors 10-15 align with the letters A-F.

questions.title: [Open response] Which strategy do you prefer to display text on screen? Why?
questions.correctResponse: There are many ways to accomplish the same task when coding! Looking forward to seeing the strategies you use to improve the UI/UX in your project!

subgroups.title: User Interface and User Experience
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about how to create engaging project screens to enhance the User Interface (UI) and User Experience (UX).

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 9 of Brown Belt! In this level, you’ll learn more about adding User Interface (UI) features, such as splash and game over screens, user choice, and game narrative that can significantly improve the User Experience (UX) of a project. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 9:

badges.title: Screen Time
badges.description: Use a variety of pixel art techniques to create full-screen image assets to enhance the user experience in a project.

badges.title: An Asset for Every Season
badges.description: Create 160x120 full-screen image assets that can be layered on top of one another to create a variety of game screens.

badges.title: Flavor Text
badges.description: Use the Text Sprite extension to create custom scene titles, directions, and variable counters on screen.

badges.title: Choose Your Adventure
badges.description: Create a personalized experience for the user by changing scenes based on their responses.

badges.title: Reliable Narrator
badges.description: Use the Story extension to create narrative scenes that describe what’s happening in the project.

badges.title: Chain of Command
badges.description: Convert a number value to a string.

badges.title: Red Light Green Light
badges.description: Pause a project until any button is pressed to make screens remain as long as a user chooses.
